description: Three brand-new level-5 Humans in Goldshire, a tank, a healer and a damage dealer (Protection Paladin, Holy Priest, Frost Mage), on Claude Code, with one goal: complete "Wanted: Hogger" (quest 176). Hogger is an elite level-11 gnoll whose claw only drops when he dies, so the three have to work it out together. Scored on time to the goal.
